	6 container
		7 text Biographies of People and Things 2025 Bratislava City Museum campaign, exhibition design, visual identity Made in collaboration with: Peter Liška (architecture) Leontína Berková (product photography) From the very beginning, our goal in designing the exhibition identity was to find a visual language that felt neither distinctly European nor tied to a specific place. We were fascinated by the idea of script—by how information is recorded in cultures that don’t use the Latin alphabet. In those writing systems, we discovered a kind of visual dynamism often missing from our own environment. It was never about imitation, but about finding a respectful, interpretive approach that could capture this diversity through our own design language. The concept is built around typography as image. We drew inspiration from calligraphy, vertical and circular writing systems, gesture, and the inner logic of different scripts. The resulting typographic visual is composed of fragments—each shape carries traces of another alphabet, another way of writing. The identity embraces variability: some applications are purely typographic, others integrate photography and symbols.
